mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS TOTAL_COUNT, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS SUCCESS_COUNT, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS = 'FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS FAILED_COUNT FROM SCHED_EXEC_LOG WHERE ACTUAL_FIRE_TIME >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND ACTUAL_FIRE_TIME < TRUNC(SYSDATE) + 1
SELECT JOB_NAME, JOB_GROUP, ACTUAL_FIRE_TIME, EXCEPTION_MESSAGE FROM SCHED_EXEC_LOG WHERE STATUS = 'FAILED' ORDER BY ACTUAL_FIRE_TIME DESC, LOG_ID DESC FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY
